faqLd.a: No. Open a .xlsx free without signing in and save on this device. Sign in and pick a cloud plan on Pricing only when the same file must follow you across devices.

faqLd.q: What happens if I close the tab?
faqLd.a: Files saved on this device stay until you delete them. Signed-in cloud workbooks are written back by save and autosave. Crash recovery copies can stay for 7 days — see the history page.

faqLd.q: Is this a full Excel replacement?
faqLd.a: No. It is built for opening attachments, everyday formulas, and format-preserving edits without installing Office. For VBA, heavy Power Query, or live co-editing, use Excel or Google Sheets.
Excel (.xlsx) is the product. The same editor also opens Word (DOCX), PowerPoint (PPTX), PDF and CSV.
